units.title: Fix firePhase() invocation in dispatchers + register HyperMillSafetyHooks
units.description: Add hookExecutor.firePhase('pre-operation') and firePhase('post-operation') calls to camDispatcher and calcDispatcher for all hyperMILL actions. Register all 6 validators from HyperMillSafetyHooks.ts in the hook pipeline. This is a 3-line fix per dispatcher but is the highest-trust-impact change: safety hooks exist (264 LOC, 45 tests) but NEVER FIRE because dispatchers don't call firePhase(). After this fix, clearancePlane, negativeAllowance, measurementSystem, and restMaterialToolChange validators will actively block unsafe operations.
